criteria.description: Describes the future from the customer's changed world/life, not the company's market position or revenue goals.
Paints a specific, vivid picture and avoids generic buzzword filler (seamless, innovative, world-class, AI-powered); a competitor couldn't simply paste their name in.
Is aspirational and inspiring while remaining believable/anchored, not pure fantasy.
Is a future-state vision, not a roadmap or feature list, and is distinct from a mission statement.
Is sharp enough to guide decisions — makes some in/out trade-offs obvious.
